name: AWS S3 Backend
description: Stores state as a given key in a given bucket on Amazon S3. S3 native lockfile locking is recommended; deprecated DynamoDB locking remains available for compatibility and migration.

attributes.name: bucket
attributes.description: Name of the S3 bucket where the state file will be stored.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Path to the state file inside the S3 bucket. When using a non-default workspace, the state path will be /workspace_key_prefix/workspace_name/key.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: AWS region of the S3 bucket. If not specified, the region will be determined from the AWS_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION environment variables.

attributes.name: encrypt
attributes.description: Whether to enable server side encryption of the state file. When true, uses AES-256 encryption by default.

attributes.name: dynamodb_table
attributes.description: (Deprecated) Name of DynamoDB table used for state locking and consistency. The table must have a partition key named LockID with type String. If not configured, state locking will be disabled.

attributes.name: kms_key_id
attributes.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of a KMS Key to use for encrypting the state. Requires encrypt to be true.

attributes.name: acl
attributes.description: Canned ACL to be applied to the state file.
attributes.deprecatedMessage: Use bucket policies instead of canned ACLs. AWS recommends disabling ACLs for most use cases.

attributes.name: workspace_key_prefix
attributes.description: Prefix applied to the state path inside the bucket when using workspaces. Defaults to 'env:'.

attributes.name: force_path_style
attributes.description: Enable path-style S3 URLs (https://s3.amazonaws.com/BUCKET/KEY) instead of virtual-hosted-style (https://BUCKET.s3.amazonaws.com/KEY). Useful for S3-compatible services.

attributes.name: use_path_style
attributes.description: Enable path-style S3 URLs. Replaces the deprecated force_path_style argument.

attributes.name: profile
attributes.description: Name of the AWS profile to use for authentication. If not set, uses the default profile or environment variables.

attributes.name: access_key
attributes.description: AWS access key ID. Use of static credentials is discouraged; prefer IAM roles, environment variables, or AWS CLI profiles.

attributes.name: secret_key
attributes.description: AWS secret access key. Use of static credentials is discouraged; prefer IAM roles, environment variables, or AWS CLI profiles.

attributes.name: token
attributes.description: Session token for temporary credentials. Required when using temporary credentials (STS assume role, etc.).

attributes.name: role_arn
attributes.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of an IAM role to assume before accessing the S3 bucket.

attributes.name: external_id
attributes.description: External ID to use when assuming the IAM role specified in role_arn.

attributes.name: session_name
attributes.description: Session name to use when assuming the IAM role specified in role_arn.

attributes.name: skip_credentials_validation
attributes.description: Skip the credentials validation via STS API. Useful for testing or when using third-party S3-compatible services.

attributes.name: skip_metadata_api_check
attributes.description: Skip the EC2 metadata API check. Useful when running outside of AWS or when metadata service is unavailable.

attributes.name: skip_region_validation
attributes.description: Skip static validation of region name. Useful for AWS-compatible implementations that may have custom regions.

attributes.name: skip_requesting_account_id
attributes.description: Skip requesting the account ID. Useful for AWS-compatible implementations that do not support STS.

attributes.name: skip_s3_checksum
attributes.description: Skip automatic checksum verification of S3 objects. May be useful for S3-compatible services that don't support checksums.

attributes.name: sse_customer_key
attributes.description: The base64-encoded 256-bit encryption key to use for server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C).

attributes.name: max_retries
attributes.description: Maximum number of retries for AWS API requests.

attributes.name: endpoints
attributes.description: Custom endpoints for AWS services. Useful for LocalStack, MinIO, or other S3-compatible services.

attributes.name: shared_credentials_files
attributes.description: List of paths to shared credentials files. If not set, defaults to ~/.aws/credentials.

attributes.name: shared_config_files
attributes.description: List of paths to shared config files. If not set, defaults to ~/.aws/config.

attributes.name: assume_role_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Number of seconds to restrict the assume role session duration. Must be between 900 and the maximum session duration configured for the role.

attributes.name: assume_role_policy
attributes.description: IAM policy in JSON format to use as a session policy for the assumed role. Restricts the effective permissions of the assumed role.

attributes.name: assume_role_policy_arns
attributes.description: Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of IAM Policies to use as managed session policies for the assumed role.

attributes.name: assume_role_tags
attributes.description: Map of assume role session tags.

attributes.name: assume_role_transitive_tag_keys
attributes.description: Set of assume role session tag keys to pass to subsequent sessions.

attributes.name: use_lockfile
attributes.description: Whether to use a lockfile for locking the state file. Defaults to false.

attributes.name: allowed_account_ids
attributes.description: List of allowed AWS account IDs to prevent potential destruction of a live environment. Conflicts with forbidden_account_ids.

attributes.name: forbidden_account_ids
attributes.description: List of forbidden AWS account IDs to prevent potential destruction of a live environment. Conflicts with allowed_account_ids.

attributes.name: custom_ca_bundle
attributes.description: File containing custom root and intermediate certificates. Can also be set using the AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable.

attributes.name: ec2_metadata_service_endpoint
attributes.description: Custom endpoint URL for the EC2 Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) API. Can also be set with the AWS_EC2_METADATA_SERVICE_ENDPOINT environment variable.

attributes.name: ec2_metadata_service_endpoint_mode
attributes.description: Mode to use in communicating with the metadata service. Valid values are IPv4 and IPv6. Can also be set with the AWS_EC2_METADATA_SERVICE_ENDPOINT_MODE environment variable.

attributes.name: http_proxy
attributes.description: URL of a proxy to use for HTTP requests when accessing the AWS API. Can also be set using the HTTP_PROXY or http_proxy environment variables.

attributes.name: https_proxy
attributes.description: URL of a proxy to use for HTTPS requests when accessing the AWS API. Can also be set using the HTTPS_PROXY or https_proxy environment variables.

attributes.name: insecure
attributes.description: Whether to explicitly allow the backend to perform "insecure" SSL requests. If omitted, the default value is false.

attributes.name: no_proxy
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that should not use HTTP or HTTPS proxies.

attributes.name: retry_mode
attributes.description: Specifies how retries are attempted. Valid values are standard and adaptive. Can also be configured using the AWS_RETRY_MODE environment variable.

attributes.name: sts_region
attributes.description: AWS region for STS. If unset, AWS will use the same region for STS as other non-STS operations.

attributes.name: use_dualstack_endpoint
attributes.description: Force the backend to resolve endpoints with DualStack capability. Can also be set with the AWS_USE_DUALSTACK_ENDPOINT environment variable.

attributes.name: use_fips_endpoint
attributes.description: Force the backend to resolve endpoints with FIPS capability. Can also be set with the AWS_USE_FIPS_ENDPOINT environment variable.

attributes.name: dynamodb_endpoint
attributes.description: (Deprecated) Custom endpoint URL for the AWS DynamoDB API. Use endpoints.dynamodb instead.

attributes.name: iam_endpoint
attributes.description: (Deprecated) Custom endpoint URL for the AWS IAM API. Use endpoints.iam instead.

attributes.name: sts_endpoint
attributes.description: (Deprecated) Custom endpoint URL for the AWS STS API. Use endpoints.sts instead.

attributes.name: endpoint
attributes.description: (Deprecated) Custom endpoint URL for the AWS S3 API. Use endpoints.s3 instead.

attributes.name: shared_credentials_file
attributes.description: (Deprecated, use shared_credentials_files instead) Path to the AWS shared credentials file. Defaults to ~/.aws/credentials.
